'''"Hydra"''' is an Overseer of the [[Fractsidus]] who is first mentioned during [[All That Sunlight Touches]]. Their identity remains unknown and "Hydra" is a codename, although [[Luuk Herssen]] was able to discover that they are the leading mind on human evolution and body modifications, often working alongside fellow Overseer [["Siren"]].

==Trivia==
===Etymology===
*{{W|Lernaean Hydra}} {{Lang|grc=Λερναῖα ὕδρα}}, more commonly referred to simply as Hydra, is a serpentine lake monster in {{W|Greek mythology|Greek}} and {{W|Roman mythology}} that was killed by {{W|Heracles}} ({{W|Hercules}}).
